name: American Smash Burger
description: The American Smash Burger is a juicy, crispy-edged burger made by smashing a beef patty on a hot griddle, topped with classic American cheese, pickles, onions, and a tangy sauce, all served on a soft bun.
fun_fact: The smash burger technique, popularized in American diners, involves pressing the burger patty thin on a hot griddle to create a crispy, caramelized crust. This method maximizes flavor and texture, making it a favorite in fast-food culture.
instructions: Divide the ground beef into 4 equal portions (about 100 g each) and roll them into loose balls. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat a cast-iron skillet or griddle over high heat until very hot. Add a small amount of butter to the skillet.
Place one beef ball in the skillet and immediately press it down firmly with a spatula to create a thin, flat patty. Repeat for the remaining beef balls, working in batches if necessary.
Cook the patties for 2-3 minutes without moving them, until a crispy crust forms on the bottom. Flip the patties and immediately place a slice of American cheese on each.
While the cheese melts, lightly toast the burger buns on the skillet or in a toaster.
In a small bowl, mix the mayonnaise, ketchup, and mustard to create the sauce.
Assemble the burgers: Spread the sauce on the bottom bun, top with a cheese-covered patty, pickles, and onions. Add the top bun and serve immediately.
